EAR: Catches sound, and holds up your glasses
EYE: The window to the soul, and to the storm
LEG: You haven't a leg to stand on without two
HIP: Where the leg meets the body, and a word for cool
JAW: Hinges your bite, and drops in shock
RIB: One of twenty-four bones caging the heart
TOE: Ten of them, and the little one finds the furniture
LIP: Seals the kiss, and gets bitten in worry
GUM: Pink bed that holds the teeth
FOOT: Twenty-six bones and a shoe size
HEAD: Houses the brain, and tops the body
BACK: Where the spine runs and the ache lives
KNEE: The hinge you fall onto to propose
NOSE: Smells everything, and grows when Pinocchio lies
CHIN: Below the mouth, and kept up when times are hard
HEEL: Back of the foot, and Achilles' weak spot
BONE: Two hundred and six of them hold you up
CHEST: Ribcage and heart, and where you keep your treasure
ANKLE: The joint you twist on a bad step
ELBOW: The funny bone that is not funny
THUMB: The opposable one, and it goes up for yes
SPINE: Thirty-three stacked bones, and a book has one too
SKULL: Bone helmet for the brain, and the pirate flag
HEART: Beats a hundred thousand times a day
KIDNEY: Bean-shaped filter, and you have a spare
SHOULDER: Where the arm joins, and burdens are carried
STOMACH: Where dinner goes, and butterflies live
